{"code": "import numpy as np

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# First, check if any revenue values have commas
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any())

# Now convert: strip commas, then cast to float
# Note: '0.00' is fine, but '1,234.56' needs comma removal
# Use .str.replace(',', '', regex=False) then pd.to_numeric

# Apply conversion
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify conversion worked
print(df[['revenue', 'revenue_float']].head())

# Now drop QA orders and refunded orders
# But QA orders were not detected earlier — check again
print(f'QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {df[df["revenue_float"] == 999999.99].shape[0]}')

# Actually, QA orders were not present in the data? Let's double-check
qa_mask = df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'QA orders actually found: {qa_count}')

# Now filter out refunded orders and QA orders
# But QA orders were not found — so only remove refunded
filtered_df = df[~(df['status'] == 'refunded')]
print(f'Rows after filtering: {filtered_df.shape[0]} out of 900')

# Check conversion rate by channel, before stratification
conv_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(f'Raw conversion rate by channel:
{conv_by_channel}')"}
